fit: Exactly the 399019 R36 FIT WAF publisher normal/anomalous originals, grouped by R26 components. Preserve original counts and R24 bounded cell loss mass. No R36 holdout, other publishers, protected evaluation or native labels in any fitting or selection.
diagnostic: Frozen R36 operating points on historical WAF development CAL_OP and SELECT; counts by component and method. Inspect exposed R36 holdout and transfer only after a separate write-once selection lock.
hypotheses: R36 boosted trees retain useful ranking. A calibration rule that caps the influence of large benign components can reduce false positives across templates.
Fourfold negative loss for high scoring normal views from out-of-component teachers can improve the low-FPR tail without adding response-time features.

arms.HGB_HARD: Same HGB with three component-disjoint cross-fitting folds on fitting data only. Mine scores above or equal to the 90th percentile across distinct negative feature cells. Multiply negative loss on mined cells by four before class balancing.

pilot: R36 FIT only, hash r37-pilot component modulo 5. Buckets 0,1,2 train; 3 calibration; 4 validation. Compare all three at the same calibration rule. Promote one boosted arm by lowest excess validation FPR over .01, then higher recall, then AP; HGB wins exact tie. Always finish the strongest boosted arm. Frozen R36 comparator and equal-calibration ExtraTrees control at full scale.
operating_point: Strict > on float32 ONNX raw score. Largest alert set satisfying <=1% original-negative FPR and <=1% negative FPR with each component's total negative weight capped at 8 originals. Only calibration labels enter this rule; one global threshold per arm. Platt probability on disjoint historical CAL_FIT, threshold on CAL_OP. Refit-stage operating point always calculated from ONNX scores.
selection: Historical WAF SELECT only at the locked cutoff. Replace frozen R36 only if the finalist has measured FPR <=1%, recall at least 3 percentage points above shipped R36, positive 2.5th percentile of the paired lineage bootstrap for recall delta, and no higher observed FPR than shipped R36. Under the equal-budget recalibrated ET control also require no higher FPR than 1% and higher recall (or control exceeds the FPR budget). No selection or threshold tuning on the exposed WAF holdout or foreign transfer. Real runtime safety and parity required before deployment.
evaluation: After selection lock: both finalist and shipped R36 on exactly the same R36 development holdout and on NOTES and SRBH development FIT/TUNING separately. Embargo whole foreign components touching any exact WAF feature across both foreign roles. Report request estimates and 95% percentile intervals resampling lineage components (2000 replicates), descriptive exact-binomial intervals, accuracy, balanced accuracy, AP, Brier and methods. These are historically exposed publisher development roles, no independent T07 TEST. Per-role best recall at 1% FPR is a diagnostic ranking ceiling only.
runtime: Use the one-thread delegated R35 guardian. Freeze the deployed slot only after benign HTTPS live acceptance, SHA, ONNX/Rust, ABSTAIN, restart, rollback, cleanup. No enforcement promotion.
